title: Blackbaud (BLKB) Q1 Earnings and Revenues Surpass Estimates
text: Blackbaud (BLKB) came out with quarterly earnings of $1.14 per share, beating the Zacks Consensus Estimate of $1.08 per share. This compares to earnings of $0.96 per share a year ago.
